info.text:
Gas prices set records in August and September, and AAA says October is on pace too.
AAA: September 2026 averaged $4.33 a gallon, 50 cents above the old September record of $3.83 from 2023.
On Oct 22, AAA said October is poised to be the most expensive October ever. The national average is about $4.29 on Oct 26, more than $1 above a year ago.
Example: a 15-gallon fill-up costs over $15 more than last year; 40 gallons a month means over $40 extra.
Sources: AAA (Oct 1, Oct 22, Oct 26, 2026).
News and education, not financial advice.
